name: i like flying :)
source:
Have I ever told you that I like flying? Well I do really like planes, and flying in general. I've flown a lot, you know. And I've learned a thing or two from my time in the air. Some of my travel experiences have been pretty weird. It's exciting stuff, you know. Sounds like your seat is right next to mine, so let me tell you all about it!

[from [url=https://cross-couloir.itch.io/i-like-flying-smile]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我有没有告诉过你我喜欢飞行？嗯，我真的很喜欢飞机，并且总体上喜欢飞行。我飞过很多次了，你知道的。我从飞行经历中学到了一两件事。我的一些旅行经历非常奇怪。你知道，这是令人兴奋的事情。听起来你的座位就在我的旁边，所以让我告诉你一切吧！

[来自[url=https://cross-couloir.itch.io/i-like-flying-smile]itch.io[/url]]
